verdict.rationale: Plaid Auth returns account and routing numbers so developers can initiate ACH debits, and the European Payments suite supports real-time payment initiation. This gives a foundation that recurring debits could be built on. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents variable recurring payments, standing consents, or a recurring debit flow. Missing for 10: explicit VRP or standing-consent support, documented recurring-debit or mandate flows, and hands-on corroboration of recurring payments.
